Ask Your Metrics

A small governed question interface. It only answers from an approved metric dictionary, shows the SQL that ran and stops when the request is unclear.

4 · Verify
What is constrained

      

        
Approved metrics
MRR, active customers, customer churn, NRR, segment MRR and invoice collection rate.

        
Read-only execution
Only registered SELECT templates, bound parameters, approved tables and a 200-row result limit.

        
Honest fallback
Ambiguous requests ask for a metric and period. Unsupported requests do not get guessed SQL.

      

    


    

      
How to read this demo

      
The Python version runs these questions against a read-only SQLite database. This browser version replays the same checked answers so it can be hosted as a static page. It is deliberately not described as a live LLM integration.
